cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Furniture announces location, not succession.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please. I already agree.

mechanism: A occupies the chair with confidence but yields the outgoing chair preferred departure format while requiring a public statement that A decides the next agenda outcome.
confusable: Unlike private reassurance or a title alone, the room must hear transfer of decision authority; borrowed confidence relies on B speaking it.
comparison: A live agenda vote differs from hall access and a committee waiting outside.
seedUse: Use D60-b chair/private chairing/to room distinction with S02-a accommodating the needed partner before asserting leadership.
